phase2Ratchet.label: TC-858 Phase 2 (#548 stack): security fences + required sync paths, approved by Naomi 2026-10-16
phase2Ratchet.toolchain: Bun 1.3.14; replica-e2e Node size job Rust 1.99.0; production webpack; gzip -9 -c

rationale.requiredAtLoad: The web root exports the Node class. Its synchronous sign-out delivery denial, TC-1208 epoch/attempt/signOutCount fences and independent non-replica OpenKey retry cannot move behind an asynchronous replica loader. The measured whole-file marginal includes OpenKey and gzip interactions; it is not a replica-only charge.

The root owns the explicit enabled-constructor registration and synchronous invalid-config refusal; sign-in/restore and wallet selection retain the TC-1208 fences. The optional recovery, storage, authority and worker remain outside the root.

The separately built optional entry calls the root's existing SDK parser and SIWE helpers through these exports, sharing one registry/session and avoiding a second copy of SDK code. This marginal overlaps the index.ts/tcw.ts row and must not be summed.

phase2Ratchet.safeCuts: Bun 1.4.3 controlled combined root reduction -385/-279 against the pre-cut S2 stack: optional-only pure scope predicate reuse -77/-36, then registered synchronous Node config validation -308/-243. S4 event correction changed root by 0. Marginals are nonadditive before-cut attribution, not fabricated exact post-cut per-file gzip; the absolute built combined root ceiling is binding. Base re-measured with the official recipe; earlier provisional base superseded.

tc1413Ratchet.label: TC-1413 typed node retry errors (NODE_BUSY, REQUEST_TIMEOUT, OUTCOME_UNKNOWN), exact canonical delta
tc1413Ratchet.ruling: Naomi TC-1413 size ruling: one reviewed exact-delta row at canonical CI bytes; worker, root, first-import and activation only, no unrelated loosening
tc1413Ratchet.reason: One shared classifier (nodeRetryError in sdk-services/src/errors.ts) maps the node's 503 sql_busy / unavailable_retryable / request_timeout and 500 outcome_unknown to NODE_BUSY, REQUEST_TIMEOUT and OUTCOME_UNKNOWN for SQL, DuckDB and KV get/head/list/put/delete, replacing the 503-as-KV_CONFLICT mapping. Cuts applied first: Retry-After is read as whole seconds only (no HTTP-date parsing), one message string per error site is shared with the classifier, and the CLI messages live in the CLI only. The first CI measurement on 90bc0ae7 was worker +946, and the two cuts took it to +827. The review then required mapping the new codes in their consumers (ShareRecipientClient.redactedCode and the operations KV and personal-record failure mappers, which also dropped the dead KV_CONFLICT paths); that moved only the root, by +27/+28, so the final source is 20c29611 with root +278/+302. Run 39099093175 measured identical absolute bytes in both jobs against merge base 3ae17bfc; the worker's 820,935 and the optional deltas are unchanged from run 39095938793. No replica-owned file changed; the growth is sdk-services and sdk-core code bundled into each artifact.

tc1436Ratchet.ruling: Naomi TC-1436 size ruling for #578: a real shrink first, remainder by the PR's own exact-delta row at canonical CI bytes; whichever of #578 and #580 lands second re-measures against the new base and updates its own row
tc1436Ratchet.reason: disableSubDelegation now emits the node's terminal UCAN fact: markDelegationTerminal in sdk-core re-signs the WASM-built session-key token with the fact after checking the key is its issuer, and TinyCloudNode wires it through the WASM wrapper and refuses the flag on wallet-signed paths. TinyCloudNode is part of the web bundle, so the feature cannot leave the root. Cuts applied first: one marker call inside createDelegationWrapper instead of one per path, a 54-character error string instead of 176, and the issuer check replacing a separate public-key check; CI went from +1349/+363 on f97d73d9 to +1327/+344 on d8e72fb9. Local ablation (Bun 1.3.14, gzip -9): helper +225/+298, wiring +183/+114. Both jobs of run 39134326448 measured identical absolute bytes against merge base 7e10709c. First import, activation, gated and the worker are unchanged.

tc1432Ratchet.label: TC-1432 vault etag, ifMatch and opt-in expectAad, exact canonical delta
tc1432Ratchet.ruling: Naomi size ruling: after a real shrink attempt, one PR-owned exact-delta row at canonical CI bytes; worker, root, first-import and activation only, no unrelated loosening
tc1432Ratchet.reason: Vault compare-and-swap and opt-in address binding in sdk-services (DataVaultService, vault types; one node-sdk mapping line): VaultEntry.etag, VaultPutOptions.ifMatch with distinct ETAG_MISMATCH / INVALID_ETAG / OUTCOME_UNKNOWN / NODE_BUSY codes, and VaultGetOptions.expectAad. sdk-services is bundled whole into the root, the kv-storage worker and the optional buckets, and the worker keeps DataVaultService through the sdk-services barrel, so any vault code is charged there. Real shrink attempts first, same-toolchain local worker gzip (Bun 1.4.3), master 819,007: the first candidate was +870 (CI +851); the review fixes (shape check before the AAD check, explicit expectAad refusals, gateway statuses as OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, the weak-etag message) took it to +1,209; folding the new default messages into the existing message-required case changed nothing (+1,249, strings gzip away); merging the shape check and the AAD check into one helper with the decrypt's own base64 decoder cut it to +1,119 (CI +1,109); importing the worker's KVService through the /kv subpath instead measured 837,823 B against the 820,256 B candidate (+17,567, it duplicates KVService) and still contains DataVaultService, so it was reverted; the vault methods are synchronous parts of one service class, so a lazy import is not possible. #578 (TC-1436) landed first, so this row was re-measured against master 129c7935 and sits on top of the TC-1436 root ceilings. Canonical CI run 39144311690 (head 83c9d75a, the merge of that master into source 490cd947 plus a policy placeholder) measured identical absolute bytes in both jobs against merge base 129c7935: root 1,466,908 / 1,396,591 B (+913 / +872 over the TC-1436 ceilings), first import 51,925 / 67,138 B (+1 / -1), activation 23,106 / 24,685 B (+1 / +2) and the worker 822,044 B (+1,109 over the TC-1413 ceiling). Whichever PR lands after this one re-measures against the new base and updates its own row.

tc1424Ratchet.label: TC-1424 #583 non-extractable share receiver key, exact canonical delta
tc1424Ratchet.ruling: Naomi's standing size rule for TC-1424 #583: a real shrink first, remainder by the PR's own exact-delta row at canonical CI bytes; whichever of #578, #580 and #583 lands later re-measures against the new base and updates its own row
tc1424Ratchet.reason: Accountless share receivers sign with a non-extractable WebCrypto Ed25519 key whose handle is kept in IndexedDB: record validation, a multi-tab add race, compare-and-delete of stale records, removal of the earlier session-storage record, memory-only fallbacks with page-memory credentials, a page-memory fallback where session storage is blocked, sessions that stop signing at expiry or forget, and forget. The receiver is part of the web bundle, so it cannot leave the root. Ed25519 is not new bytes: @noble/curves/ed25519 was already bundled once through sdk-core and share-envelope and still is. Cuts applied first: no transaction timeout wrapper and no per-request promise helper (one transaction-completion promise instead); the local measurement went from +1499/+1265 to +1383/+1171, and CI measured +1382/+1225 on d1e4c3d3. The review fixes on 7672d834 (expiry and forget in sign, compare-and-delete, the blocked-storage fallback, credential storage chosen by the session) took CI to +1677/+1456 against 7e10709c, and +1677/+1444 against 129c7935 after #578. After #580 landed, the merge 55145dbb measured +1673/+1286 against 1d7b78fd in both Replica jobs, which this row admits; first import, activation, gated and the worker are unchanged. Not taken: a lazy import, because the web build pins LimitChunkCountPlugin({ maxChunks: 1 }) and would inline it; dropping forget, multi-tab handling, stored-record validation or the review fixes.

tc1448Ratchet.label: TC-1448 #591 terminal-grant did:pkh recipient guard, exact canonical delta

tc1448Ratchet.reason: delegateTo, and so createDelegation and space.delegations.create, throw for disableSubDelegation: true with a did:pkh recipient, because the node refuses a wallet-mode useDelegation of a terminal parent. Shrink attempts first (same-toolchain local gzip, Bun 1.4.3, master 1d7b78fd): the first candidate added a separate 100-character error string, +74 / +55; reusing the existing TERMINAL_DELEGATION_REQUIRES_SESSION_KEY constant for the new refusal (its text now also names the did:key rule and keeps its old prefix) and one shared throw took it to +49 / +58 locally, +41 / +31 on canonical CI against the TC-1432 base. A lazy import would be inlined by the single-chunk root build, and the check has to run in the web root because TinyCloudWeb.createDelegation forwards to delegateTo. tc1443Ratchet.label: TC-1443 #586 sdk-core registry verdict classifier, exact canonical delta
tc1443Ratchet.ruling: TC-1443 size row for #586, approved by Naomi as a delta (+2,368/+61 gzip, ±50 B), 2026-10-18; re-measured on 70304c3d, following the TC-1436 (#578) size ruling pattern: a real shrink first, remainder by the PR's own exact-delta row at canonical CI bytes
tc1443Ratchet.reason: sdk-core adds classifyRegistryLookup (registry-verdict.ts): a pure three-state classifier of one location registry response with its own strict JSON parser, RFC 3339 check, signature encoding rules and host-origin mapping. web-sdk does not export it; the index.mjs build still keeps the whole module, while index.cjs tree-shakes all but its module-level constants. Cut applied first: the module took secp256k1's group order from sdk-core's @noble/curves 1.9.7 while viem bundles its own 1.9.1, so the root carried a second secp256k1; a pinned literal replaced it, and CI went from +12398/+6881 on 8776001a (against 7e10709c) to +2423/+49 on 4a8ccb1a (against 129c7935). Not taken: a lazy import, because the web build pins LimitChunkCountPlugin({ maxChunks: 1 }) and would inline it; changing how the mjs build tree-shakes sdk-core, which is a web-sdk build change outside this PR. #583 (TC-1424), #584, #588, #592, #593 and #591 (TC-1448) landed first; this row was re-measured against master 70304c3d (CI-measured at 7539b854, run 39165869299: index.mjs 1,468,625 and index.cjs 1,397,910 B, equal to the TC-1448 ceilings) and chains after the TC-1448 row. Canonical CI run 39166751086 (head 72ba295c, the merge of that master into source 4a8ccb1a plus a policy row carrying placeholder numbers) measured identical absolute bytes in both Node jobs: index.mjs 1,470,995 and index.cjs 1,397,981 B, i.e. +2,370 / +71 over master's measured bytes, within the approved delta of +2,368 / +61 gzip (+/-50 B). The ceilings are these measured bytes, zero headroom. Whichever PR lands after this one re-measures against the new base and updates its own row.

tc1466Ratchet.label: TC-1466 #595 receiver key kept across a clock race between tabs, exact canonical delta
tc1466Ratchet.ruling: Naomi size ruling: a real shrink attempt first, remainder by the PR's own exact-delta row at canonical CI bytes (approved as +12 / +6 gzip, +/- 10 B); rows chain after the latest on master
tc1466Ratchet.reason: restorePersisted refused a stored receiver key whose createdAt was later than the caller's now, which was read when the tab started. A peer tab that started a moment later stores a record stamped with its own later clock, so this tab judged it future-dated, deleted it and generated a second key (flaky 'tabs opening at once share one stored key', master run 39162127319). Both restores now read the clock when they run. The fix cannot be free: it adds one clock read at each restore. Shrink attempts first (same-toolchain local gzip, Bun 1.4.3, master 1d7b78fd, base +0 / +0): reading the clock inside restorePersisted and compacting its comparison +15 / +13; additionally deduplicating the lifetime fields shared by the memory and persisted sessions +13 / +12 (gzip already shares them); a 2 s tolerance on the future-dated comparison using the existing storage timeout constant +8 / +5, rejected because it loosens the guard against future-dated records for 3 bytes; the chosen two inline fresh clock reads +11 / +5 locally and +12 / +6 on canonical CI, identical in both jobs of run 39172186671 on b2725dd6 (master 28ca77a0 merged into the PR branch), over TC-1443's ceilings.

tc1428Ratchet.label: TC-1428 #582 owner-signed artifact pin for addressed shares, exact canonical delta
tc1428Ratchet.ruling: Naomi's standing size rule for TC-1428 #582: a real shrink first, remainder by the PR's own exact-delta row at canonical CI bytes; rows chain after the latest row on master, so whichever PR lands later re-measures against the new base and updates its own row
tc1428Ratchet.reason: The viewer now checks the owner-signed artifactPin: assertArtifactBinding and verifyArtifactShare in share-sdk/src/artifact-pin.ts, the strict artifactPin field in the Policy/v3 envelope schema, and their call sites in resolvePolicyShare and ShareRecipientClient.decryptV3Content. Root only: the worker, first-import, activation and gated artifacts are unchanged. Cuts applied first: the layout helpers and the owner-side helpers (buildArtifactPin, verifyArtifactManifestBytes, verifyArtifactFileBytes) live in the separate @tinycloud/share-sdk/artifact entry and are not in the web bundle; pin errors use their code as the message (-159 gzip bytes in a share-sdk proxy build); the recipient no longer re-hashes the fetched bytes, because the binding already makes the pinned digest equal contentSource.initialCiphertextDigestHex, which decryptV3Content checks (-56). Reused: verifyEnvelopeV3SignatureOnly for the signature, the noble sha256 already bundled, and the existing ciphertext digest check; sdk-core and share-envelope hold no equivalent. Not taken: a lazy import, because the web build pins LimitChunkCountPlugin({ maxChunks: 1 }) and would inline it; a subpath for the verifier, because the viewer must run it; dropping the expected-artifact check or the edit refusal, each worth about 35 bytes. Local builds measured +1127/+993 before these cuts. Review changes then showed two canonical-CI surprises that local builds do not reproduce: a zod .max() on the pinned size moved the ESM root by +911..+924, so the bound lives in assertArtifactBinding instead (+17), and folding the two receive-path signature checks into one saved nothing. Re-measured after #579, #580, #583, #584, #585, #586, #587, #588, #589, #591, #592, #593 and #595 landed: run 39181586326 on source 90f21ae6 (a merge of master 42b08909) measured identical absolute bytes in both jobs, +915 / +812 over TC-1443b's ceilings. The earlier run on ae2b05bc (master 28ca77a0) measured +911 / +767 over TC-1443's, so the moves in between add +4 / +45 to this PR's own cost.

tc1475Ratchet.label: TC-1475 #599 automatic retry of node busy and request-timeout responses, exact canonical delta
tc1475Ratchet.ruling: Naomi's standing size rule for TC-1475 #599: a real shrink first, remainder by the PR's own exact-delta row at canonical CI bytes; rows chain after the latest row on master
tc1475Ratchet.reason: ServiceContext.invokeWithRetry(url, build) retries node 503 busy and request_timeout responses and calls build once per attempt, so every attempt carries a freshly signed invocation: the node records each invocation before its handler runs and answers a repeat with 409, so the first version, which re-sent the identical request, could never succeed. KV, SQL, DuckDB and the hooks webhook calls go through one BaseService.invokeWithRetry helper; the RetryPolicy defaults, the RetryStats on responses and KVResponse.retry, and the retryPolicy plumbing in web-sdk and node-sdk are unchanged. sdk-services is bundled into the root, the kv-storage worker and the optional first-import and activation buckets, so each moves by its measured delta. Real shrink first: the abortable sleep is shared with HooksService instead of a second copy, one helper builds every signed request, the debug timing reuses one meta object, and the new doc comments are single lines because the unminified worker bundle keeps JSDoc. The first fix of the re-mint (run 39257200762, source e8cd279a) measured the worker at 822,915 (+871 over TC-1432's); the shrink brought it to 822,620 (+576). Base: master c7a379c5 (it includes #598, whose root rows are -74 / -171 and set no ceiling); PR: GitHub run 39261202208 on source b83cf61a measured the same bytes in both Node jobs: root index.mjs 1,475,110 (+275 over TC-1428's ceiling, +349 over the merge base) and index.cjs 1,403,543 (+234 over TC-1428's, +405 over the merge base), first-import replica.mjs 51,925 / replica.cjs 67,138 (0 / 0), activation activation.mjs 23,114 / activation.cjs 24,697 (+8 / +12 over TC-1432's) and the kv-storage worker 822,620 (+576). Each ceiling is exactly the measured value.
